parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource. For example, when ResourceType is set to instance, ResourceId is the instance ID.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the ECS resource. Valid values:

- instance: instance.
- disk: block storage.
- snapshot: snapshot.
- image: image.
- securitygroup: security group.
- ddh: dedicated host.
- ddhcluster: dedicated host cluster.
- eni: network interface controller (NIC).
- keypair: key pair.
- launchtemplate: launch template.
- command: Cloud Assistant command.
- activation: Cloud Assistant managed instance activation code.
- managedinstance: Cloud Assistant managed instance.

The preceding parameter values are case-sensitive.
